## Description

A clear summary of what this PR changes and why. If it fixes an issue, reference it here.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New exercise or script
- [ ] New or updated cheat sheet / notes
- [ ] Refactor or reorganization
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other

## How Has This Been Tested?

Describe how you verified the changes work as expected (e.g., ran the script, checked links, reviewed output).

## Checklist

- [ ] Code runs without errors
- [ ] `README.md` is included or updated for any new exercise or script
- [ ] No sensitive data (credentials, keys, personal info) is committed
- [ ] All links and file paths are correct
- [ ] Commit messages are clear and descriptive
- [ ] The [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) has been followed
